newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Coffee again to open sharply down after NY.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Coffee again to open sharply down after NY.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Robusta coffee futures should again open sharply lower, continuing the frenzied sell-off initiated in both the London and New York markets, traders and analysts said on Tuesd
London traders said they expected the market to open an average $100 lower than Monday's close, calling benchmark July to open as much as $130 lower and second-month September $75 lower.
London was likely to see renewed speculator and fund profit-taking as prices retraced lower after the battered New York arabica market tumbled for the second day in a row.
"I expect we'll see that in London this morning," said one.

Robustas failed to recover from an early sharp dive on Monday and July finished with a 14 percent loss, putting a temporary end to last week's winning streak which took prices to the highest level in 20 months.
Traders said the well-overbought market was also long overdue for a downward correction.
Fundamentally, top-grower Brazil is now of paramount interest as it enters this year's frost season.
Although frost-free conditions to date have already prompted some nervous speculators to take profits, analysts said any threat of frost was likely to spark a buying spree -- re-igniting a bull run.

No damaging cold is forecast for coffee areas through to this weekend but local weathermen have said an approaching air mass should be monitored as it was coming in overland and would be arriving when coffee regions were already cool. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
